column1: # ZAP rules for the API scan in CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml, job dast).
# Any alert not set to IGNORE here fails the build.

column4: The API serves only JSON, which browsers do not MIME-sniff into script or HTML.
A bearer-token JSON API is not embedded as a cross-origin resource, so CORP adds nothing.
CI scans the plain-HTTP local Compose stack. TLS is out of scope for this project (docs/Decisiones.md, Simplificaciones frente a producción); a deployment terminates TLS in front of the API.
